We specialize in analyzing and recovering lost or declined transactions that may still be chargeable with the use of machine learning and predictive analytics. Where BetterCharge elects to approve a transaction, it may provide coverage to you for such transaction, subject to the terms of any separate agreement between you and BetterCharge. You acknowledge that approval of a transaction does not guarantee that the underlying payment method will be successfully charged, and that any coverage provided by BetterCharge is conditional, limited, and governed by the applicable commercial agreement. 2. BetterCharge is not a payment processor, payment gateway, acquiring bank, issuing bank, or merchant of record. BetterCharge does not process payments directly but operates in conjunction with third-party payment providers and financial institutions.
